name: Slugify function
description: Text normalization verified by unit test. Edge cases: punctuation runs, leading and trailing separators
prompt: Write solution.js in the sandbox. It must use CommonJS and export a function slugify(text). slugify lowercases the text, turns every run of characters that are not a-z or 0-9 into a single hyphen, and removes hyphens at the start and end. The tests are in test_slugify.js; read them first. Use write_file. Then reply with the word done.
